summary:
A red-brick high-street shop house with a steep dark-slate front gable, built over one butcher's unit (a Folio and its door stalls) under a 9-wide maroon fascia, a red-and-white awning and two dark-oak pilasters. There is a separate lobby bay for the home stair, and two storeys of white-trimmed home windows mirrored about the gable. A lower two-storey back wing on the west makes the L, and the fenced vegetable garden behind (four beds, paths, gate from a side passage) reads as a family's plot. Red-brick high-street shop house, steep dark-slate front gable, L-plan with back wing and fenced kitchen garden; butcher's maroon fascia, striped awning and pink/brown/red display over one Folio plus stalls.
Shop at ground (sockets untouched), home on two floors above, loft; six trade parts. elements.md and plan.md sections written.

concept_subject: A narrow, handsome red-brick shop house standing alone on its plot in a shopping street, its steep dark-slate gable facing the road. At pavement level a tall open shopfront nine blocks wide sits between two dark-oak pilasters. Behind the counters, butcher's goods show in pink, brown and red blocks: pork chops, baked chicken and steaks. Over the shopfront runs a deep maroon fascia lettered BUTCHER in white, with a red-and-white striped awning hanging from it. A dark-oak hanging sign juts from the right-hand pilaster. To the left is a smaller bay with the family's own double door, a fanlight and a little timber hood with a lantern at each end. Above, a crisp white cornice carries two storeys of brick with three paired sash windows per floor, set back into the wall under white lintels, with dark shutters on the top floor. White quoins climb the corners. The gable has a small loft window and dark-oak verges with a slate ridge, and a dormer pokes from each side slope. A tall brick chimney with a dark band and smoking cap rises up the east side beside a gravel passage that leads to a spruce garden gate with a lamp post. Behind, a lower two-storey brick back wing runs off the west half under its own slate gable, with a smoking kitchen chimney on its end. The rest of the back is a fenced kitchen garden: farmland beds of carrots, potatoes, beetroot and wheat with water channels, dirt paths from the kitchen door and the shop's back door, compost bins, a water butt, a bench and an apple tree in the far corner.
